name: 3-powerful numbers that can be written as the sum of two coprime 3-powerful numbers.
comment: Any counterexample to the Beal conjecture, i.e., the statement that the Diophantine equation A^x + B^y = C^z has no solution for pairwise coprime A, B, C and x, y, z > 2, has to be a term from this sequence.
link: A. Nitaj, On a conjecture of Erdős on 3-powerful numbers, Bull. London Math. Soc. 27 (1995), no. 4, 317-318.
author: _Felix Fröhlich_, Jan 07 2018
